title: Download selected authorized supplier aging page as PDF
description: Purchasing user downloads selected current supplier aging page as paginated Chinese PDF using PDFsharp and shared SimHei resolver; split wide fields across pages. Development only; reuse existing SupplierReconciliationAging.ForQueryAsync evidence, current-user purchase-order menu authorization and HTTP audit. Preserve explicit due-date unknowns, separate currencies, draft/void history and invalid/unknown allocation evidence. Fail closed on missing permission, invalid requests or source failures. No payment approval, ledger inference, arbitrary SQL, migration, production SQL, real database execution, business writes, secrets/.env or deployment. Verify focused tests and safe Release build/test; no browser acceptance.
acceptance_criteria: PDF endpoint reuses authorized bounded preview and rechecks menu, filters and selected fields before bytes.
PDF renders selected fields, Chinese labels, separate currencies and unknown due/remaining evidence across row and column pages without clipping; missing SimHei fails visibly.
Designer offers PDF with visible empty/authorization/font errors; tests inspect signature, selected fields, page bounds, unknowns, font failure and no writes; document font prerequisite.
